selection_contract.authority: Visual selection only. MapView owns world and discovery state. Persist selected asset ID or deterministic variant keyed by stable world feature identity; no redraw RNG.
selection_contract.lod: Prefer symbol at small sizes where available; illustration at normal and closer zoom. Resolve unknown IDs explicitly, never invent an established kind or coordinates.
selection_contract.anchors: Normalized x/y within source rectangle; use anchor at world feature location, preserve aspect ratio.
selection_contract.transparency: 248 transparent ink/decoration assets; only two blank parchment substrates are opaque.
selection_contract.hash: git_blob_sha1 is Git's SHA-1 over blob header plus exact SVG bytes; byte_size is exact repository blob length.
